method: Read two existing 12.3 MB legacy JSON files and the existing bounded D118 projection; sum request input_tokens/output_tokens; sort by request_id before exact ID, adapter, scheduled-arrival and token-count comparisons. No GPU run, raw D118 reload, new trace, or source mutation.
measurement_caveat: Legacy token totals are recorded fields, not independently reverified native token counts. Missing old prompt hashes prevent content-equality verification. Same token counts do not prove same prompt text. Contract differences remain; no causal performance ratio or confidence interval.

d118_input_count_audit.method: Compare input_tokens to native_token_timing.actual_prompt_tokens, sum canonical_prompt_tokens, and record all unique input_tokens minus canonical_prompt_tokens values in the existing D118 projection.

interpretation: Recorded input workload decreases and output total increases modestly; large TTFT differences cannot be attributed to a proportionally larger token workload from these counts alone. Queue amplification near capacity remains possible; no isolated bottleneck attribution is established. Current performance remains OPEN.
